executiveSummary: Marketing Operations & MarTech Specialist who builds the systems that run marketing for a 3-brand, 22-location automotive dealership group, not just the campaigns on top of it. Designed and built a proprietary CRM and lead-operations platform (LeadForge) from zero, a Digital Asset Operations system now tracking 200+ assets across locations, and the workflow that took Google Business Profile coverage from 2 to 17 verified locations. Runs content production end-to-end — directing external videographers and designers on website, logo, and video work, while personally shooting and editing photo/video content and trial reels (CapCut, Filmora, Affinity Suite) to test formats before scaling. Comfortable operating at the intersection of marketing, engineering, and analytics — writes production Python/Flask and Google Apps Script, integrates the Meta Graph API and WhatsApp Business API, and reports on GA4 and Google Business Profile data through self-built dashboards. Looking to bring the same systems-first approach to a Marketing Operations, MarTech, or CRM Operations team with more scale and more hands to build alongside.

experience.title: Marketing Operations & Digital Marketing Associate

experience.intro: Sole digital marketing function for a 3-brand, 22-location dealership group across Uttar Pradesh. Owns strategy, systems, and execution end-to-end.
bullets: Designed and built LeadForge, a proprietary marketing operations platform (Flask/PostgreSQL) replacing informal spreadsheet-based lead tracking. Runs lead intake, lifecycle tracking, Meta/WhatsApp integration, and reporting for 826+ active leads across all three brands.

Recovered ~600 unattended Meta leads sitting untouched at the time of joining by designing a structured intake-to-assignment workflow, and cut average lead response time to under 30 minutes during business hours.

Architected a Digital Asset Operations system to solve a 22-location content bottleneck — a low-friction upload and tagging workflow usable by non-technical showroom staff, now tracking 198+ marketing assets with automatic status sync and cross-brand visibility.
Designed and executed the workflow that took Google Business Profile presence from 2 to 17 verified, fully-optimised locations, including on-site verification across multiple Uttar Pradesh districts.
Rebuilt 5 dealership websites from the ground up (Cloudflare Pages) with technical SEO fixes, GA4/GTM/Search Console instrumentation, and conversion-focused lead capture forms.

Directed cross-functional creative vendors, coordinating with freelance videographers and graphic designers on website revamps, logo design, and video shoots — translating brand and business goals into creative briefs, shot lists, and design direction.

Built and scaled WhatsApp Business API infrastructure (Gupshup) end-to-end — number import/provisioning, 50,000+ segmented contacts, and broadcast campaigns with A/B tested messaging to improve response rates.

Own hands-on creative production — campaign concepts, shot lists, and editing briefs, plus personally shooting and editing content and trial reels (CapCut, Filmora, Affinity Suite) to validate formats before scale.
Currently designing a GBP/Looker Studio analytics pipeline (Apps Script → PostgreSQL → Flask) to unify performance reporting across all 22 locations, pending Google API quota approval.

bullets: Managed Meta Ads, Local SEO, and Google Business Profile optimisation for 17 local businesses, generating 1,000–2,000 monthly campaign responses on ad budgets as low as ₹3,000/month.

infrastructure.title: LeadForge — Marketing Operations Platform
infrastructure.problem: lead activity for 3 brands across 22 locations lived in disconnected spreadsheets and WhatsApp threads, with no accountability or lifecycle visibility.
infrastructure.built: a Flask/PostgreSQL CRM with canonical record IDs per brand, automated reconciliation against Google Sheets, role-based assignment, Meta and WhatsApp Business API integration, and an employee performance dashboard — now in its 25th+ iteration with full technical documentation.
infrastructure.result: 826+ leads under active, trackable management; 700+ processed through structured workflow; the architecture is now being explored for multi-tenant SaaS productization.

infrastructure.title: Digital Asset Operations System
infrastructure.problem: marketing assets from 22 locations had no central tracking — files were lost, duplicated, or never made it from showroom floor to published post.
infrastructure.built: a Google Apps Script-based intake and lifecycle logger with automatic categorisation, publication-status tracking, and daily reconciliation, designed for zero-training use by non-technical showroom staff.
infrastructure.result: 198+ assets tracked end-to-end with full lifecycle visibility, replacing what had been an untracked, manual process.

infrastructure.title: Local Presence & GBP Operations Framework
infrastructure.problem: only 2 of 22 dealership locations had a functioning, accurate Google Business Profile — most local search traffic was invisible.
infrastructure.built: a repeatable verification and optimisation workflow, executed through direct field visits across multiple Uttar Pradesh districts, plus the operating process for maintaining profile accuracy at scale.
infrastructure.result: 17 locations verified and fully operational, materially expanding local search and Maps visibility for the dealership group.
